verdict.rationale: WooCommerce's developer docs say it includes native support for the Model Context Protocol, letting AI assistants interact directly with stores. A probe confirms a dedicated official MCP documentation page exists, so an agent can connect through a first-party MCP server. The evidence is limited to that one-line summary, though. missing for 10: details on the tools/capabilities exposed, authentication and permission model, client setup instructions, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the server works as described.
